svg.title: MONSTER GPU POWER
svg.desc: GPU power limit (TGP) profiles from 125 to 150 W; a community tool for the Monster Tulpar T5 V21.7.

g.text: Six ready-made profiles, one click — saved in the OEM profile file
Monster Tulpar T5 V21.7 · Windows 10/11 x64 · community tool · GPL-3.0
Not affiliated with the manufacturer · no network connection, telemetry or ads
